svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Introduction to Kubernetes, slide 11 of 12: High availability
svg.desc: High availability: pods are spread over zones a, b and c; when the instructor stops the node in zone b, the load balancer keeps sending visitors to the ready pods in zones a and c, and after about 30 seconds Kubernetes re-creates the two lost pods there; the control plane is replicated by Google; the weak spot is the single Postgres pod with its disk in one zone (in this picture: zone a).
svg.text: Copies live in 3 zones. Stop a node and the rest keep serving while Kubernetes moves its pods.
sends visitors only to ready pods
replicated by Google in all 3 zones: it survives a zone too
Honest weak spot: one Postgres pod, one disk in one zone
Lose THAT zone and the API waits for it. Stop a node in another zone. Production: Cloud SQL.
